subject: Allowance increment for scale POC - BrightMetrics
messages:
From: Diane Kim <diane.kim@brightmetrics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial allowance increase for scale test

Hi Olga / Rafael,

Hope you
re well. We're ramping up the BrightMetrics POC next week and would like to run a 48-hour throughput validation to validate end-to-end latency at 500 req/s (expected ~1.2M tokens/day). Our current trial allowance will be exhausted within the first 12 hours of the run.

Can Redwood provision a temporary quota bump (tokens or credit) to cover ~2.5M tokens over a 72-hour window, and optionally extend the trial period by two weeks while we complete results analysis?

High-level schedule:
- Start: Wed 2027-05-05 08:00 PT
- Peak run: Wed 2027-05-05 10:00 - Thu 2027-05-06 22:00 PT
- Target SLAs to validate: p95 latency < 180ms, and sustained throughput 500 req/s at 4-token average response length

I've attached our load config (load-config.yaml) and a short checklist for the run.

If you need more details on the workload or a tech contact, loop in Alex (eng lead) at alex@brightmetrics.com.

Thanks,
Diane
Diane Kim
Head of Product Engineering | BrightMetrics
--Attachment: load-config.yaml (text/yaml)
--Attachment: poc-run-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Diane Kim <diane.kim@brightmetrics.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial allowance increase for scale test

Hi Diane,

Thanks for the details and the config file — very helpful. We can support a temporary allowance increase but need an approval path for promotional credits and a precise provisioning window. Iopied Ben (sales ops) to help approve the one-time promo allocation.

Quick questions to expedite:
- Do you need the allowance as token credits (recommended) or as a time-limited rate quota?
- Is BrightMetrics able to sign a short mutual action plan (MAP) confirming test dates and reuse limits? We typically ask for a non-production clause for trial provisioning.

Proposal from our side (provisional):
- One-time credit: 250,000 tokens, valid for a 7-day window beginning the morning of your run (we can start provisioning 24 hours prior).
- Trial extension: +14 days to your trial expiration date (conditional on the MAP).

If that works, Ben will finalize the promo approval and Rafael will coordinate provisioning with infra. After approval wee sure to turn on the quota and share console access with your engineers.

I'll mark this high priority.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
--Attachment: provisioning-note.txt (text/plain)
